subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the core read tool add a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader native document/file-input handling?
rationale: The source-level problem is still present, but the issue mixes a small safe fallback with broader document parsing and provider-forwarding choices that affect ownership, dependencies, and security review.

options.title: Land narrow fallback
options.body: Add a bounded guard for known PDF/Office document formats that returns a clear unsupported-file message and points users to document-specific tools.

options.title: Use the open candidate PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to resolve conflicts and add current-main proof, then review that branch as the implementation path.

options.title: Fold into broader document work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the document extraction and provider-native file-input issues and solve read behavior as part of that architecture.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fallback
recommendation.body: Add a bounded guard for known PDF/Office document formats that returns a clear unsupported-file message and points users to document-specific tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest release-history signal for the current read-tool files points here, and the decision is about the current read-tool boundary.
